title: ComponentStatus
description: Schema for the MEDIATE ComponentStatus heartbeat entity. This entity is periodically published by MEDIATE components to report their availability, runtime status, health state, uptime, and version. It supports integration-level monitoring and can later be used by ComDeX-based Zero Trust monitoring mechanisms.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be componentStatus.

component.description: Relationship. MEDIATE component whose runtime status and health state are reported by this heartbeat entity.

componentType.description: Property. Type or role of the MEDIATE component. Examples include DSS, POLICY_MANAGER, SERVICE_MANAGER, ORCHESTRATOR, DASHBOARD, SENTINEL, OVERWATCH, CTI, and SRDU.

status.description: Property. Runtime status of the component.

healthStatus.description: Property. Higher-level health interpretation of the component status.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the component status heartbeat was generated.

uptime.description: Property. Number of seconds the component has been running. This field is optional.

version.description: Property. Version of the component publishing the heartbeat.
